policies.text: Vendor designation as a Tier 1 supplier requires an enterprise admitted to the Premier Vendor Network that registers zero severe safety incidents per year.
Top product placement in the catalog is assigned to any business achieving Tier 1 Supplier Status that maintains yearly commercial liability coverage of at least $2,000,000.
Wholesale distribution authorization at high volumes requires minimum annual sales of 20,000 units.
Inclusion in the Green Goods Index is granted to any entity holding organic product certification.
Special trade concessions are granted to exporters maintaining an annual shipping output of at least 1,000 metric tons.
Listing in the Premier Vendor Network requires either yearly research spending of at least $400,000 or holding ISO 9001 Certification.
Fast-track patent processing is permitted for applicants maintaining five or more active utility patents.
Enrollment in the Extended Protection Program is open to products carrying a warranty duration of at least 5 years.
